summary: Open text-to-speech system with large models for expressive, multi-character speech and long content.

heroCommands.command: Follow the installation guide at speech.fish.audio/install

sixtySeconds.whatItDoes: Fish Speech is a text-to-speech project from Fish Audio. Its models include Drama 3, a 35B mixture-of-experts flagship (3B active per token) for multi-character scenes and long content, and the faster 4B S2-Pro. Both share the same command line and API server.
sixtySeconds.problem: Natural, expressive speech for long or multi-voice content is hard to get from open models. Fish Speech provides strong open weights with a CLI, API server and web UI.
sixtySeconds.whyChoose: Choose it for state-of-the-art open TTS models, with fast serving options through SGLang-Omni or vLLM-Omni.
requirements: See the installation docs for environment setup and weights

overview: The README points to the docs for installation (environment setup, downloading weights, Docker) and inference (command line, API server and WebUI).
For efficiency, the team recommends serving with SGLang-Omni; a vLLM-Omni recipe also exists. The model type is detected from the checkpoint's config.
The code and weights use the Fish Audio Community License, and S2-Pro weights use the Fish Audio Research License, so check the license before commercial use. Use voice features only with consent.
limitations: Install steps are in the docs
